title: FBI Photo B19
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military system showing an unidentified anomalous phenomenon (UAP), submitted by the FBI to AARO.
interpretation_warnings: The source PDF page contains no readable text — all facts are derived from the CSV metadata description and narrative description provided by war.gov, not from text within the document itself.
The image was redacted before submission to AARO, meaning potentially identifying details (HUD data, coordinates, system information) were removed.
No mission report was provided, so there is no operational context for the sighting.
The system date/time was not set, making the timestamp unreliable for dating the event.
Single-source observation with no corroborating sensor data mentioned.
The object appears only as a small cluster of dark pixels, providing very limited visual information for identification.
